SELECT -- CPU指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'cpu.usage' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'cpu.cores' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_cores, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'cpu.load.1min' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_1min, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'cpu.load.5min' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_5min, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'cpu.load.15min' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS cpu_load_15min,
-- 内存指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'memory.usage' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS memory_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'memory.total' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS memory_total, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'memory.available' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS memory_available, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'memory.used' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS memory_used,
-- 磁盘指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'disk.usage' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS disk_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'disk.used' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS disk_used, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'disk.total' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS disk_total,
-- 网络指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'network.rx.rate' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS network_rx_rate, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'network.tx.rate' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS network_tx_rate, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'network.rx.bytes' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS network_rx_bytes, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'network.tx.bytes' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS network_tx_bytes, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'network.rx.errors' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS network_rx_errors, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'network.tx.errors' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS network_tx_errors,
-- JVM指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'jvm.heap.usage' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS jvm_heap_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'jvm.heap.max' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS jvm_heap_max, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'jvm.thread.count' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS jvm_thread_count, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'jvm.class.loaded' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS jvm_class_loaded,
-- OS指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'os.process.count' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS os_process_count, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'os.thread.count' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS os_thread_count, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'os.uptime.seconds' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS os_uptime_seconds,
-- 进程指标 MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.cpu.usage' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS process_cpu_usage, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.memory.resident' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS process_memory_resident, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.jvm.uptime' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS process_jvm_uptime, MAX(CASE WHEN metric_name = 'process.id' THEN metric_value ELSE NULL END) AS process_id,
-- 采集时间 MAX(collect_time) AS collect_time
FROM metric_data WHERE probe_id = #{probeId} AND collect_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' GROUP BY probe_id ORDER BY collect_time DESC LIMIT 1
